rebuttalDraft.text: Merchant responds to Mastercard 4853 chargeback. The transaction of $1,299.00 on 2026-04-28 was fully authorized (see evidence [d5b6e00b-b9c8-57f3-bbb3-fd350b097ed6]). The order was fulfilled as specified — one unit of SKU TW-LAPTOP-PRO-15 shipped in original OEM packaging (see evidence [9f8f616f-7618-5bdf-abff-4cda8540a341]). The cardholder contacted support on 2026-05-10 claiming the keyboard was defective; our support team offered an exchange within the 30-day return window, which the cardholder declined (see evidence [cea0442e-7cd4-5d19-a6d1-7330084a855d]). The cardholder's refusal of the offered remedy does not constitute grounds for a chargeback.
